name: @grey-ridge/elizaos-plugin-defi-data
description: DeFi/market data for Base trading agents (ElizaOS) with a decision layer: ranked yields + risk score, per-pool SUSTAINABLE/DECAYING/OUTLIER/AVOID entry verdict, spot prices, cross-venue funding with OI-weighted arb verdict, and SAFE/CAUTION/AVOID token safety — paid inline with x402 USDC from $0.001/call, no API key.
author: Grey Ridge Signals Group LLC

DEFI_DATA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Hex private key of the agent's Base wallet; signs the per-call x402 USDC payment (from $0.001/call). Omit to run keyless on the free preview path (real data, limited depth).

DEFI_DATA_BASE_URL.description: Override the Grey Ridge data endpoint base URL (defaults to the hosted Worker).

DEFI_DATA_CHAIN.description: Default chain filter for GET_DEFI_YIELDS, e.g. 'Base' or 'Ethereum'.

DEFI_DATA_POOL.description: Default DefiLlama pool id for YIELD_ENTRY_VERDICT when none is in the message.

DEFI_DATA_TOKEN.description: Default Base ERC-20 contract for CHECK_TOKEN when none is in the message.

DEFI_DATA_COINS.description: Default comma-separated coin ids/tickers for GET_CRYPTO_PRICES when none is in the message.
